description:
Preview the operations required to reconcile an existing subtree with target JSX. The tool returns a create, update, delete, and move plan without changing the canvas, and preserves the ID of each matched node.

Workflow:

1. Call `read_jsx({ node })` for the current subtree.
2. Edit the returned JSX.
3. Call `reconcile_preview({ scope: node, markup: editedJsx })` with the same root ID.

When the plan is within runtime safety caps, the result also contains `previewToken`, `previewVersion`, and `previewHash`. They bind one reconcile_apply call to this exact scope, markup, and live canvas snapshot for 120000ms. Pass all three unchanged. If the canvas changes, the credential expires, or it was already used, preview again. An oversized plan returns `applicable:false` and no credential.

markup.description: Target JSX describing the desired subtree — same dialect as read_jsx output

scope.description: Node id of the existing subtree to reconcile (the "file")

name: reconcile_preview
